verdict.rationale: Lowenstein Sandler is a law firm, but it has a digital, agent-facing presence (an llms.txt file and the Clerky partnership platform), so asking about a public API is a fair question in a startup-legal-services comparison. No evidence shows any API, versioning scheme or deprecation policy, and the probe found every OpenAPI/Swagger candidate path returning 404. The Clerky workflows are a partner platform's feature, not a Lowenstein API, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
